compliance_time_text: Group 1 (s/n up to 1363): within 25 flight hours after 15 August 2024 (effective date of the original issue), deactivate the Advanced Start System per SB-773-CS. Group 2 (s/n 1364 and up): no deactivation required.
unsafe_condition_summary: Out-of-schedule activation of the engine soft start at high power reduces RPM and could cause further loss of power, with increased pilot workload and reduced control of the aeroplane.

out_of_scope_features.quote: If requested and appropriately substantiated, EASA can approve Alternative Methods of Compliance for this AD.

revises: Revision: This AD revises EASA AD 2024-0152 dated 01 August 2024.
compliance_time_text: Groups: Group 1 are aeroplanes having s/n up to 1363 inclusive. Group 2 are aeroplanes having s/n 1364 and up.

(1) For Group 1 aeroplanes: Within 25 flight hours after 15 August 2024 [the effective date of the original issue of this AD], modify the aeroplane by deactivating the Advanced Start System in accordance with the instructions of the SB-773-CS.
unsafe_condition_summary: This condition, if not corrected, could lead to further occurrences of loss of power, with possible increased pilot workload and reduced control of the aeroplane.

notes: EASA AD: no Federal Register number. serial_from/serial_to null = all serial numbers. The two conditions are both required (AND): the AD applies only if neither MOD2008/233 nor SB-826-CS is embodied. No Supersedure field in the text: supersedes is [] with no quote. effective_date is Revision 1 (05 February 2025); the original issue was effective 15 August 2024. data/raw/INDEX.md gives 27 Feb 2025 for R1, which the text does not support.
